rules.message: Sold out — this event has no tickets left.
rules.check: const r = await ctx.db.query('select capacity, sold from event where id = $1', [row.event_id]); const rows = Array.isArray(r) ? r : (r && r.rows) || []; const e = rows[0]; if (!e) return 'Event not found'; if (Number(e.sold) >= Number(e.capacity)) return 'Sold out — this event has no tickets left.'; return true;

rules.message: Already checked in — this ticket was used.
rules.check: if (ctx.old && ctx.old.used && row.used) return 'Already checked in — this ticket was used.'; return true;

do.code: const ev = await ctx.db.get('event', String(row.event_id)); if (!ev) return; await ctx.db.update('event', String(row.event_id), { sold: Number(ev.sold) + 1 });
const ev = await ctx.db.get('event', String(row.event_id)); if (!ev) return; await ctx.db.update('event', String(row.event_id), { checked_in: Number(ev.checked_in) + 1 });

const t = new Date(ctx.now().getTime() + 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const events = await ctx.db.list('event'); const tickets = await ctx.db.list('ticket'); for (const ev of events) { if (new Date(ev.starts_at as string).toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== t) continue; for (const tk of tickets) { if (String(tk.event_id) !== String(ev.id) || tk.used) continue; await ctx.db.create('reminder', { attendee_id: tk.attendee_id, event_id: ev.id, title: 'Tomorrow: ' + String(ev.title), message: 'Doors at ' + String(ev.venue) + ' open tomorrow. Your ' + String(tk.tier_name) + ' pass is ready in My tickets.' }); } }
